hostname rt-w01
!
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encryption aes 256
 hash sha256
 authentication pre-share
 group 14
 lifetime 28800
crypto isakmp key dummy-psk-site-w address 203.0.113.20
crypto isakmp keepalive 30
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-Tunnel1 esp-aes 256 esp-sha-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel1
 set transform-set TS-Tunnel1
 set pfs group14
 set security-association lifetime seconds 3600
!
interface Dialer1
 description sample pppoe
 ip address negotiated
 ip mtu 1454
 ip nat outside
 ip tcp adjust-mss 1414
 encapsulation ppp
 dialer pool 1
 ppp authentication chap pap callin
 ppp chap hostname sample-w@example.com
 ppp chap password dummy-pppoe-secret-w
 ppp pap sent-username sample-w@example.com password dummy-pppoe-secret-w
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample wan port
 pppoe enable group global
 pppoe-client dial-pool-number 1
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample lan
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel1
 description sample vpn
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip nat inside
 ip tcp adjust-mss 1300
 tunnel source Dialer1
 tunnel destination 203.0.113.20
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel1
 no shutdown
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 Dialer1 1
ip route 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.128 Tunnel1 1
!
ip access-list extended acl-w-nat
 permit ip 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255 any
!
ip nat inside source list acl-w-nat interface Dialer1 overload
!
ip dhcp excluded-address 198.51.100.1 198.51.100.10
ip dhcp pool pool-w-lan
 network 198.51.100.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 198.51.100.1
 dns-server 192.0.2.53
 lease 1
!
end
